commitResults.messageBody:
Renamed Duke to Jeryl to move away from the placeholder chatbot name,
per Level-0 instructions. Updated the ASCII banner and references in
README.md and docs/README.md accordingly, and filled in the student
profile placeholders in AGENTS.md, and updated the Java version setup
instructions to match this machine's actual setup (Homebrew-installed
Java 25, not sdkman).

Update main() to greet the user with the chatbot's name and purpose,
then print a farewell message before exiting, per Level-0 instructions.
No input handling yet — the chatbot still exits immediately.

Read user input in a loop and echo each line back until the user
types "bye", per Level-1 instructions. Uses a Scanner over System.in.

Store each entered line as a task in a fixed-size array (up to 100
tasks) and add a "list" command to display them with 1-based
numbering, per Level-2 instructions. No persistence to disk yet.

Track completion status for each task with a parallel boolean array
and add a "mark INDEX" command to set a task as done. "list" now
shows the [X]/[ ] status icon. No new classes introduced yet.

Add an "unmark INDEX" command that reverses a task's done status,
completing the base Level-3 requirement before introducing the
A-Classes extension.

Introduce a Task class to hold a task's description and done status,
replacing the parallel String[]/boolean[] arrays with a single
Task[] array. This is the A-Classes extension for Level-3.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for todo, deadline, and event tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Extend Task with a type marker and optional by/from/to fields (no
new classes yet) and parse "todo", "deadline .../by ...", and
"event .../from .../to ..." commands. Task#toString() renders the
[T]/[D]/[E] prefix and any date/time info. Dates/times are kept as
plain strings for now.

Introduce Todo, Deadline, and Event as subclasses of Task, replacing
the type-flag field and by/from/to fields on Task itself. Each
subclass overrides toString() to render its own type prefix and
detail suffix. This is the A-Inheritance extension for Level-4.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle minimal errors: empty todo, unknown command
commitResults.messageBody:
Print an OOPS!!! message instead of crashing when a "todo" command
has no description, or when the input doesn't match any known
command, per the minimal Level-5 requirement.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JerylException and comprehensive error handling
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce a custom JerylException and use try/catch around command
processing so no input can crash the program. Covers: empty todo/
deadline/event descriptions, missing /by or /from+/to, missing or
non-numeric or out-of-range task numbers for mark/unmark, and unknown
commands. This is the A-Exceptions extension for Level-5 (typical
level: all current commands covered).

Add a "delete INDEX" command that removes a task from the array,
shifting later entries down. Reuses the existing parseTaskIndex
validation, so an invalid or missing index is reported gracefully.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use ArrayList instead of a fixed-size array
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace Task[100] + manual taskCount bookkeeping with ArrayList<Task>,
removing the artificial 100-task cap and the manual shift-down loop
in delete. This is the A-Collections extension for Level-6.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use an enum for command dispatch
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce a Command enum (LIST, MARK, UNMARK, DELETE, TODO, DEADLINE,
EVENT, BYE, UNKNOWN) and switch on it instead of a long chain of
String startsWith/equals checks. Each command's logic is extracted
into its own private method for readability. This is the A-Enums
extension.
